Master Yoda.notes: From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide), team: The Jedi Council Survivors. Species unknown: set wound and strain thresholds with your GM. Soak is Brawn before armor.

Master Mace Windu.name: Master Mace Windu
Master Mace Windu.motivation: Justice - "Destroy the Sith once and for all"
Master Mace Windu.background: A master of combat who survived Order 66 and now serves as the Council's military strategist and combat instructor.
Master Mace Windu.notes: From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide), team: The Jedi Council Survivors. Wound and strain thresholds are species base + Brawn / Willpower. Soak is Brawn before armor.

Master Ki-Adi-Mundi.name: Master Ki-Adi-Mundi
Master Ki-Adi-Mundi.motivation: Knowledge - "Preserve Jedi wisdom for future generations"
Master Ki-Adi-Mundi.background: The Council's keeper of knowledge who maintains the Jedi archives and trains new Padawans in the ways of the Force.
Master Ki-Adi-Mundi.notes: From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide), team: The Jedi Council Survivors. Wound and strain thresholds are species base + Brawn / Willpower. Soak is Brawn before armor.

Master Shaak Ti.name: Master Shaak Ti
Master Shaak Ti.background: A guardian master who specializes in protecting civilians and training Jedi in defensive combat techniques.
Master Shaak Ti.notes: From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide), team: The Jedi Council Survivors. Wound and strain thresholds are species base + Brawn / Willpower. Soak is Brawn before armor.

Master Plo Koon.name: Master Plo Koon
Master Plo Koon.motivation: Duty - "Lead from the front in starfighter combat"
Master Plo Koon.force: Enhance (Basic + Control: Piloting), Sense (Basic + Control), Move (Basic)
Master Plo Koon.background: A master pilot who leads the Council's starfighter operations and trains Force-sensitive pilots in aerial combat.
Master Plo Koon.notes: From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide), team: The Jedi Council Survivors. Wound and strain thresholds are species base + Brawn / Willpower. Soak is Brawn before armor.

Master Kit Fisto.name: Master Kit Fisto
Master Kit Fisto.motivation: Discovery - "Explore the Living Force in nature"
Master Kit Fisto.background: A master scout who leads missions into dangerous environments and teaches Jedi to connect with the Living Force in all its forms.
Master Kit Fisto.notes: From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide), team: The Jedi Council Survivors. Wound and strain thresholds are species base + Brawn / Willpower. Soak is Brawn before armor.

Director Orson Krennic.name: Director Orson Krennic
Director Orson Krennic.motivation: Ambition - "Rise to ultimate power within the Empire"
Director Orson Krennic.background: A brilliant but ruthless Imperial Director who coordinates intelligence operations across multiple sectors to maintain Imperial control.
Director Orson Krennic.notes: From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide), team: The Imperial Intelligence Cell. Wound and strain thresholds are species base + Brawn / Willpower. Soak is Brawn before armor.

Agent Kallus.name: Agent Kallus
Agent Kallus.background: A skilled ISB agent specializing in infiltrating Rebel cells and gathering intelligence on anti-Imperial activities.
Agent Kallus.notes: From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide), team: The Imperial Intelligence Cell. Wound and strain thresholds are species base + Brawn / Willpower. Soak is Brawn before armor.

Captain Thrawn.name: Captain Thrawn
Captain Thrawn.motivation: Knowledge - "Understand enemies through their art and culture"
Captain Thrawn.background: A brilliant Chiss strategist who serves as the cell's tactical analyst, using cultural knowledge to predict enemy behavior.
Captain Thrawn.notes: From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide), team: The Imperial Intelligence Cell. Wound and strain thresholds are species base + Brawn / Willpower. Soak is Brawn before armor.

Slicer Specialist LT-319.name: Slicer Specialist LT-319
Slicer Specialist LT-319.background: An elite Imperial slicer who maintains communication security and conducts electronic warfare against Rebel computer systems.
Slicer Specialist LT-319.notes: From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide), team: The Imperial Intelligence Cell. Wound and strain thresholds are species base + Brawn / Willpower. Soak is Brawn before armor.

Death Trooper DT-5537.name: Death Trooper DT-5537
Death Trooper DT-5537.background: An elite Death Trooper who serves as the cell's heavy weapons specialist and close protection for high-value Imperial assets.
Death Trooper DT-5537.notes: From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide), team: The Imperial Intelligence Cell. Wound and strain thresholds are species base + Brawn / Willpower. Soak is Brawn before armor.

TIE Pilot Baron Valen Rudor.name: TIE Pilot Baron Valen Rudor
TIE Pilot Baron Valen Rudor.motivation: Glory - "Prove Imperial superiority in space combat"
TIE Pilot Baron Valen Rudor.background: An elite TIE pilot who provides air support for Imperial operations and hunts down Rebel starfighter squadrons.
TIE Pilot Baron Valen Rudor.notes: From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide), team: The Imperial Intelligence Cell. Wound and strain thresholds are species base + Brawn / Willpower. Soak is Brawn before armor.

Vessa Morrow.npcFaction: Galactic Empire (answers to the throne alone)
Vessa Morrow.talents:
Talents: Adversary 2, Parry 3, Reflect 3, Saber Throw, Toughened 1, Grit 1
Abilities: Force Rating 3. Force powers: Move (Basic, Strength 1, Range 1); Influence (Basic, Control: instil terror); Sense (Basic, Control).
Vessa Morrow.gear: Armored robes (Defense 1, Soak +1), imperial writ, encrypted comlink
Vessa Morrow.notes:
Human: Dark side agent of the Imperial throne.
Tactics: Opens by isolating the strongest hero with Move, then duels them while her troops pin the rest.
Thresholds: wounds 10 + Brawn 3, +2 Toughened; strain 10 + Willpower 4, +1 Grit.
Taken from a frontier world as a child and trained in a dark tradition the Empire never admits exists, Vessa now hunts relics and rogue Force users wherever the throne points her. She is courteous, patient and utterly convinced that mercy is a lie the weak tell themselves.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Admiral Caddock Strell.talents:
Talents: Adversary 2, Commanding Presence 2, Field Commander, Natural Leader
Abilities: Fleet assets: in a space encounter he may add one Setback die to the heroes' Piloting checks each round while his flagship is in range.
Admiral Caddock Strell.gear: Admiral's dress uniform, code cylinders, command datapad, a Star Destroyer he treats as an extension of his will
Admiral Caddock Strell.notes:
Human: Imperial sector fleet commander.
Tactics: Never fights in person: he moves fleets, closes hyperlanes and makes the heroes come to him.
Thresholds: wounds 10 + Brawn 2; strain 10 + Willpower 3.
A careful, methodical officer who rose by never once being surprised. Strell keeps a file on every crew that has escaped him and studies them the way other men study sabacc hands; the heroes are about to become his favourite problem.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Hessimo the Hutt.talents:
Talents: Adversary 2, Nobody's Fool 2, Black Market Contacts 2, Know Somebody
Abilities: Ponderous: never takes more than one move maneuver a turn. Surrounded: never met without at least one group of Hutt Cartel Enforcers.
Hessimo the Hutt.gear: Gilded repulsor throne, encrypted ledger of debts, 40,000 credits in bribes and favours
Hessimo the Hutt.notes:
Hutt: Crime lord of the Varrek Spur.
Tactics: Talks first, bargains second and has his enforcers start shooting only once the deal has visibly failed.
Thresholds: wounds 13 + Brawn 3; strain 11 + Willpower 4.
Hessimo owns a string of refuelling stations on a hyperlane spur nobody else bothered to claim, which means sooner or later everyone owes him. He collects debts in favours rather than credits, and the heroes are exactly the kind of favour he likes to own.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Warlord Draal Vizhan.talents:
Talents: Adversary 2, Barrage 2, Durable 1, Jump Up, Toughened 1
Abilities: Jetpack: as a maneuver, fly to anywhere within medium range.
Warlord Draal Vizhan.gear: Battered Mandalorian armor (Defense 1, Soak +2), jetpack, trophy belt of enemy helmet crests
Warlord Draal Vizhan.notes:
Mandalorian Human: Exiled Mandalorian raider chief.
Tactics: Lands in the middle of the fight by jetpack, burns the cover, and dares the best fighter to face him.
Thresholds: wounds 10 + Brawn 4, +2 Toughened; strain 10 + Willpower 3.
Cast out of his clan for refusing to stop a raid on a settlement under its protection, Draal decided that if he had no clan he would make one from anyone hungry enough. His raiders strip outlying colonies bare, and he respects only those who stand and fight him face to face.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Commodore Ressa Tolvane.talents:
Talents: Commanding Presence 2, Field Commander, Master Starhopper 1, Known Schematic
Abilities: Amphibious: breathes underwater and suffers no movement penalties in water.
Commodore Ressa Tolvane.gear: Fleet uniform, encrypted comlink keyed to her flagship, the escort corvette Quiet Tide (see Vehicles)
Commodore Ressa Tolvane.notes:
Mon Calamari: Rebel fleet commander and patron.
Tactics: As an ally, she gives orders rather than taking them: once a session she can grant the heroes a Boost die on a check made to carry out her plan.
Thresholds: wounds 10 + Brawn 2; strain 10 + Willpower 3.
Ressa commands a scratch flotilla of refitted escorts that has survived three years by never fighting a battle it could lose. She hires crews like the heroes for the jobs her fleet cannot be seen doing, and she always pays, eventually.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Master Seylin Darrow.npcFaction: None; quietly aids the Rebellion (powerful ally)
Master Seylin Darrow.talents:
Talents: Parry 2, Reflect 2, Sense Danger, Healing Trance 1
Abilities: Force Rating 3. Force powers: Heal (Basic, Strength, Control: Revive); Sense (Basic, Control, Duration); Seek (Basic, Insight).
Master Seylin Darrow.gear: Plain healer's robes, field medkit, lightsaber hidden in a walking staff, holocron of medical lore
Master Seylin Darrow.notes:
Mirialan: Surviving Jedi healer in hiding.
Tactics: Avoids violence entirely if she can; when cornered she defends, disarms and heals whoever falls, friend or foe.
Thresholds: wounds 10 + Brawn 2; strain 10 + Willpower 5.
Seylin was a healer in the Jedi Temple and survived the purge because she was elbow-deep in a plague ward on a world nobody remembered. She runs a free clinic under a false name and will teach a Force-sensitive hero only once she is sure they would rather mend than fight.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Garrison Stormtrooper Squad.talents:
Talents: None
Abilities: Disciplined: as long as an officer is within short range, the squad automatically passes its first fear check each encounter.
Garrison Stormtrooper Squad.gear: Stormtrooper armor (Soak +2), utility belt, comlink, two frag grenades
Garrison Stormtrooper Squad.notes:
Human: Imperial garrison infantry.
Tactics: Advance in pairs from cover to cover, and always call for reinforcements before the shooting starts.
Minion group of 4: wound threshold 5 each (20 for the group). Group skills (Athletics, Discipline, Melee, Ranged (Heavy)) roll at rank = minions still standing - 1; the ranks shown are for the full group.
The squad garrisoning a small Imperial outpost: bored, well drilled and convinced nobody would dare attack them. Use one squad per two heroes, plus one more if they are veterans.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Hutt Cartel Enforcers.talents:
Talents: None
Abilities: Paid by the hour: if half the group is defeated, the rest flee unless their boss is watching.
Hutt Cartel Enforcers.gear: Heavy clothing (Soak +1), comlink, a datapad of names that owe money
Hutt Cartel Enforcers.notes:
Mixed (Nikto, Gamorrean, Human): Cartel leg-breakers.
Tactics: Surround the target and threaten first; they are paid to collect, not to die.
Minion group of 3: wound threshold 5 each (15 for the group). Group skills (Brawl, Coercion, Ranged (Light)) roll at rank = minions still standing - 1; the ranks shown are for the full group.
Hired muscle from any cartel-owned cantina: the ones who show up to remind a hero about a debt. Pairs naturally with Hessimo the Hutt or Customs Prefect Ondo Haskel.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Void Jackal Boarders.talents:
Talents: None
Abilities: Zero-g raiders: no penalties for fighting in low or zero gravity.
Void Jackal Boarders.gear: Armored clothing (Defense 1, Soak +1), magnetic boots, breaching charges, breath masks
Void Jackal Boarders.notes:
Mixed (Weequay, Human, Klatooinian): Pirate boarding crew.
Tactics: Blow the airlock, flood the corridor, and grab anything that is not nailed down. They retreat to their ship the moment the cargo is aboard.
Minion group of 5: wound threshold 4 each (20 for the group). Group skills (Athletics, Coordination, Melee, Ranged (Heavy)) roll at rank = minions still standing - 1; the ranks shown are for the full group.
Five desperate pirates who have done this a hundred times. Drop a group into any ship encounter that ends with the two hulls clamped together.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Sentry Droid Patrol.talents:
Talents: None
Abilities: Droid: does not need to breathe, eat or drink, and is immune to poisons and toxins. Ion-vulnerable: ion weapons deal full damage to them.
Sentry Droid Patrol.gear: Armor plating (Soak +2), integrated scanner, alarm uplink to the facility
Sentry Droid Patrol.notes:
Droid: Armed security droids.
Tactics: Hold a perimeter, sound the alarm on first contact, and shoot anything without a valid transponder code.
Minion group of 3: wound threshold 6 each (18 for the group). Group skills (Perception, Ranged (Heavy), Vigilance) roll at rank = minions still standing - 1; the ranks shown are for the full group.
Cheap, tireless and very literal. Clever heroes can slice their command frequency (a Hard Computers check) to turn them around, or simply walk past while carrying a crate marked with the right code.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Customs Prefect Ondo Haskel.talents:
Talents: Convincing Demeanor 1, Nobody's Fool 1
Abilities: Authority: while in his starport, he can call a group of Hutt Cartel Enforcers or port guards in one round.
Customs Prefect Ondo Haskel.gear: Customs authority badge, datapad of every manifest filed this month, a drawer of confiscated contraband
Customs Prefect Ondo Haskel.notes:
Gran: Starport customs prefect.
Tactics: Fights with paperwork: impounds ships, freezes accounts and "loses" permits until someone pays him.
Rival: no strain threshold; strain it would suffer is taken as wounds.
Ondo has run customs at the same starport for twenty years and has never once filed an honest report. He is a perfect recurring rival: never worth killing, always worth bribing, and always remembering who embarrassed him.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Kyx Rellin.talents:
Talents: Adversary 1, Full Throttle, Skilled Jockey 1
Abilities: Pack leader: usually rides with a group of three gang members (use the Hutt Cartel Enforcer profile on swoops).
Kyx Rellin.gear: Armored riding leathers (Soak +1), goggles, a Razorback swoop (see Vehicles)
Kyx Rellin.notes:
Zabrak: Leader of the Red Dust swoop gang.
Tactics: Fights from the saddle: makes passes at speed, shoots, and never stops moving.
Rival: no strain threshold; strain it would suffer is taken as wounds.
Kyx won the Red Dust in a race nobody else survived and has been trying to live up to the legend ever since. Beat him in a race and he becomes a loyal contact; beat him in a fight and he becomes a lifelong enemy.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Lieutenant Corwen Sythe.talents:
Talents: Adversary 1, Nobody's Fool 1, Quick Draw
Abilities: Informants: once a session he knows one thing about the heroes they thought was secret.
Lieutenant Corwen Sythe.gear: Armored clothing (Defense 1, Soak +1), forged identity papers, interrogation droid on call
Lieutenant Corwen Sythe.notes:
Human: Imperial security field agent.
Tactics: Prefers to watch, record and arrest later; if forced into a fight he shoots first and calls for stormtroopers.
Rival: no strain threshold; strain it would suffer is taken as wounds.
Sythe is ambitious, clever and one promotion away from becoming a nemesis. Every time the heroes slip away from him, add a talent; the day he finally corners them, he should feel earned.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Brask Odu.talents:
Talents: Expert Tracker 1, Stalker 1
Abilities: Findsman rituals: before a hunt he reads the omens; once a session he adds an automatic Success to a check to locate his quarry.
Brask Odu.gear: Armored clothing (Defense 1, Soak +1), ammonia breather, binders, mesh tape, a tracking fob
Brask Odu.notes:
Gand: Gand findsman and bounty hunter.
Tactics: Tracks the quarry for days, then waits for them to be alone; prefers stun and binders to a corpse.
Rival: no strain threshold; strain it would suffer is taken as wounds.
Brask speaks of himself in the third person and has never lost a quarry he chose to follow. He is honourable in his way: offer him a better story than his contract and he may let a hero go.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Kesh Varonne.talents:
Talents: Sniper Shot, True Aim 1, Lethal Blows 1
Abilities: Hide and shoot: if no hero has spotted her, her first shot in an encounter upgrades its ability once.
Kesh Varonne.gear: Camouflage cloak (+1 Boost to Stealth), padded undersuit (Soak +1), macrobinoculars
Kesh Varonne.notes:
Human: Mercenary sniper.
Tactics: Sets up at extreme range, takes one aimed shot per round, and moves the moment anyone gets close.
Rival: no strain threshold; strain it would suffer is taken as wounds.
A former planetary guard marksman who discovered she was paid better for the same work in private. Kesh is calm, professional and never personal; she will happily work for the heroes next week.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Captain Sorrel Vaank.talents:
Talents: Adversary 1, Field Commander, Toughened 1
Abilities: Company commander: always accompanied by one or two minion groups of Lancers.
Captain Sorrel Vaank.gear: Laminate armor (Soak +2), command comlink, company contract (always read the fine print)
Captain Sorrel Vaank.notes:
Weequay: Commander of Vaank's Lancers.
Tactics: Leads from the second rank, sends his Lancers (use the Void Jackal Boarders profile) in first, and surrenders the moment a fight stops being profitable.
Rival: no strain threshold; strain it would suffer is taken as wounds.
Sorrel has fought on both sides of a dozen wars and will tell you about all of them. His Lancers are loyal because he pays on time and never wastes lives, which makes him a good employer and a frustrating enemy.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

IX-4 \"Hush\".talents:
Talents: Adversary 1, Lethal Blows 2, Stalker 1
Abilities: Droid: does not need to breathe, eat or drink, and is immune to poisons and toxins. Silent running: adds a Setback die to checks to hear or detect it.
IX-4 \"Hush\".gear: Armor plating (Defense 1, Soak +2), sound dampeners, encrypted contract memory
IX-4 \"Hush\".notes:
Droid: Assassin droid.
Tactics: Strikes from ambush, withdraws when damaged, and returns days later with a better plan.
Rival: no strain threshold; strain it would suffer is taken as wounds.
Nobody knows who built Hush or who holds its contract; its memory wipes itself if it is captured. It is a good rival for heroes who think they have finally escaped their past.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Jaro Teskarr.npcFaction: Independent; scores points for the Scorekeeper
Jaro Teskarr.talents:
Talents: Adversary 2, Expert Tracker 2, Lethal Blows 1, Toughened 1
Abilities: Regeneration: heals 1 extra wound when he recovers; can regrow lost limbs over weeks. Claws: +1 Brawl damage, Crit 3.
Jaro Teskarr.gear: Laminate armor (Soak +2), trophy rack of Wookiee and Jedi trinkets, tracking kit, hunting skiff
Jaro Teskarr.notes:
Trandoshan: Big-game and bounty hunter.
Tactics: Herds the quarry into terrain he has already prepared, then nets the strongest and shoots the rest.
Thresholds: wounds 12 + Brawn 4, +2 Toughened; strain 9 + Willpower 3.
Jaro hunts for points in a tradition older than the Republic, and the heroes are worth a great many of them. He is honest about what he is, keeps his word, and will hunt a hero across a dozen worlds for the sheer glory of it.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Commander Liss Andrade.talents:
Talents: Adversary 2, Commanding Presence 2, Field Commander, Grit 1
Abilities: Air support: once per encounter, if her gunship Ironhand One is overhead, she calls a strafing run (a Gunnery attack from the gunship).
Commander Liss Andrade.gear: Padded armor (Soak +2), command helmet with squad comlink, the patrol gunship Ironhand One (see Vehicles)
Commander Liss Andrade.notes:
Human: Commander of Andrade's Ironhands.
Tactics: Plans the fight before it starts: gunship overhead, two squads on the flanks, and a negotiated surrender offered at exactly the right moment.
Thresholds: wounds 10 + Brawn 3; strain 10 + Willpower 3, +1 Grit.
Liss built the Ironhands from deserters of three armies and runs them better than any of those armies ran her. She makes a superb employer, a terrifying enemy and, if the heroes are lucky, the rival who one day becomes their most valuable ally.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Razorback.vNotes:
A racing swoop with a cannon bolted under the nose. Fast, twitchy and unforgiving: a pilot who fails a Piloting check with Despair is thrown clear.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Skyhound.vNotes:
The workhorse of a city or planetary patrol. Low ceiling (cannot leave atmosphere), but in canyons and streets it is the fastest thing the heroes will meet.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Ashwing.vNotes:
A swept-wing interceptor from a small independent yard: faster than most fighters it meets, but its light hull does not forgive mistakes.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Dusk Lantern.vOwner: Any crew that needs a home
Dusk Lantern.vNotes:
A boxy, dependable freighter with a cockpit pod, two turrets and a cargo hold just large enough for trouble. Ready-made as the party ship: add smuggling compartments (1 hard point) and it is everything a crew needs.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Ironhand One.vNotes:
A heavily armored troop gunship that can land a squad, cover them from the air, and drag a fleeing freighter back with its tractor beam.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).

Quiet Tide.vNotes:
A slim escort corvette refitted as a fleet command ship. At Silhouette 5 it has four defense zones and gets only one pilot-only maneuver per round, so the heroes' fighters run rings around it while its turbolasers handle anything larger.
From 100 Sample Characters & Vehicles (The Star Wars RPG Guide).
